facts.text: Lianna was the fourth planet of the Lianna system in the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Lianna was the fourth planet of the Lianna system in the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: Lianna was conquered by many warlords from the Tion Cluster in the planet's early history, though it later fell under the jurisdiction of the Kingdom of Barseg by the time of the formation of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Lianna was conquered by many warlords from the Tion Cluster in the planet's early history, though it later fell under the jurisdiction of the Kingdom of Barseg by the time of the formation of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Its inhabitants claimed that the planet was never, however, a part of the Kingdom of Cron or Xim's empire, though this claim to independence was mocked by many other Tionese, as during Xim the Despot's reign Lianna was a bleak agricultural world with a population of only a few thousand.

evidence.quote: Its inhabitants claimed that the planet was never, however, a part of the Kingdom of Cron or Xim's empire, though this claim to independence was mocked by many other Tionese, as during Xim the Despot's reign Lianna was a bleak agricultural world with a population of only a few thousand.

facts.text: The Galactic Senate overlooked Lianna, so the planet continued to be ruled as a traditional territory.

evidence.quote: The Galactic Senate overlooked Lianna, so the planet continued to be ruled as a traditional territory.

facts.text: At approximately 300 BBY, the Senate eventually decided to take control of Lianna from Barseg, though some two hundred years later, Sienar Technologies set up operations on Lianna, after the planet continued to be misused as an industrial center even after the Senate's intervention.

evidence.quote: At approximately 300 BBY, the Senate eventually decided to take control of Lianna from Barseg, though some two hundred years later, Sienar Technologies set up operations on Lianna, after the planet continued to be misused as an industrial center even after the Senate's intervention.

facts.text: Under the control of Kerred's granddaughter, Valles Santhe, the planet remained independent and proud of its economic power, though it eventually supported the Republic during the Clone Wars, during which the Battle of Lianna was fought.

evidence.quote: Under the control of Kerred's granddaughter, Valles Santhe, the planet remained independent and proud of its economic power, though it eventually supported the Republic during the Clone Wars, during which the Battle of Lianna was fought.

facts.text: The battle destroyed much of Lianna's urban sprawl.

evidence.quote: The battle destroyed much of Lianna's urban sprawl.

facts.text: Following the Declaration of a New Order, Lianna became a supporter of the Galactic Empire until Emperor Palpatine's defeat at the Battle of Endor.

evidence.quote: Following the Declaration of a New Order, Lianna became a supporter of the Galactic Empire until Emperor Palpatine's defeat at the Battle of Endor.

facts.text: At this point, Valles Santhe was in control of Lianna and the Allied Tion, and though the New Republic was respectful enough of her command not to intercede on her rule, surviving Imperial forces launched a series of reprisal attacks on the planet.

evidence.quote: At this point, Valles Santhe was in control of Lianna and the Allied Tion, and though the New Republic was respectful enough of her command not to intercede on her rule, surviving Imperial forces launched a series of reprisal attacks on the planet.

facts.text: Fortunately, as Lianna produced many of the Empire's TIE fighters, Santhe was able to hold off the attacks by threatening to cease production.

evidence.quote: Fortunately, as Lianna produced many of the Empire's TIE fighters, Santhe was able to hold off the attacks by threatening to cease production.

facts.text: The threat, plus some well-placed bribes, allowed Lianna to remain neutral by special charter of the Empire.

evidence.quote: The threat, plus some well-placed bribes, allowed Lianna to remain neutral by special charter of the Empire.

facts.text: The picture from the cover of Mission to Lianna re-uses a concept illustration for the planet Bespin by Ralph McQuarrie for The Empire Strikes Back.
entities: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

evidence.quote: The picture from the cover of Mission to Lianna re-uses a concept illustration for the planet Bespin by Ralph McQuarrie for The Empire Strikes Back.

facts.text: Lianna City, or simply Lianna, was the capital city of Lianna. It was located across the Lona Cranith River from the city of Lola Curich.

evidence.quote: Lianna City, or simply Lianna, was the capital city of Lianna. It was located across the Lona Cranith River from the city of Lola Curich.

facts.text: Lola Curich was a city on Lianna. It contained the Allied Tion Historical Society, Thorip Norr, Fronde's Airspeeders, the Astromech Heaven outlet, and PetVac.

facts.text: Sky City was a city and spaceport located on the northernmost end of the continent of Landra on Lianna. Of the two cities located on Landra—the other being Northwest—it was the oldest of the two.

facts.text: Anxarta was a city on the northern coast of Anai, on the planet Lianna. It was the location of Anxarta Spaceport, which was mainly used by transport and private starships supplying foodstuffs to the local tourist resorts.

facts.text: Melford was a Lianna city that was located on the northern coast of the Anai continent. Generally considered the prettiest city on the planet with well manicured lawns and generally clean air, it was the site of the Imperial-controlled Melford Star Academy.

evidence.quote: Melford was a Lianna city that was located on the northern coast of the Anai continent. Generally considered the prettiest city on the planet with well manicured lawns and generally clean air, it was the site of the Imperial-controlled Melford Star Academy.

facts.text: The Melford Star Academy, also called the First Star Academy or simply the Imperial Naval Academy, was a branch of the Imperial Naval Academy located on Melford, a Lianna city situated on the northern coast of Anai.
